title: docs(changeset,plugin-detail): date the two rotted release-note sentences and correct the born-false parity-test claim (objectui#9637)
body:
Fixes #9637

Clause-②: no

objectui#9627's four post-PASS residuals. Three sentences repaired, the fourth measured and left. The judgement is per SITE, not per card (objectui#9713), and each verdict below was established where that card says it has to be.

## Verdicts

| site | verdict | established at | repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| `7129-…-hideempty.md`, "an authored `hideEmpty` of either polarity is now inert" | ROTTED | write-time ref `1f31d3af6`, 2026-09-03 | re-dated, falsifier named, original text kept |
| `7064-empty-section-default.md`, "No application metadata needs editing" | ROTTED | write-time ref `eeb6c2f2b`, 2026-09-01 | re-dated, falsifier named, original text kept |
| `recordDetailsInputs.spec-parity.test.ts`, "Neither fact is written down as a verdict anywhere in this file" | BORN FALSE | write-time ref `542718f45` | corrected outright |
| objectui#9627 body, "Pre-existing non-English strings in these files are left alone" | false, and only partly reachable | merged PR body + immutable squash commit message | named, not touched |

## 1 + 2 — ROTTED, so re-dated rather than overwritten

Both sentences were TRUE when written, and overwriting them would erase that — a false record of its own. Both are kept verbatim, dated, and followed by a dated note naming the card that falsified them.

**`7129`.** At the write-time ref the key really was inert: the renderer carried no `hideEmpty` slot (5 occurrences, all comments), `DetailSection` carried no `section.hideEmpty` read (0 code reads), and the declaration in `packages/types/src/views.ts` was a RETIRED comment block. Lit control on the same instrument, same ref, same file: `showBorder` returns 1. Falsified by objectui#8603's restoration, shipped by objectui#9627 on 2026-09-16, which put `hideEmpty: s.hideEmpty ?? true` back.

⚠️ The adjacent scope line in the same paragraph — "the unauthored default is unchanged" — rotted with it and by the same merge. It is inside the paragraph being repaired, the same defect class, and mechanical, so the dated note covers the paragraph rather than leaving half of it standing. Evidence is the same measurement; nothing else was touched.

**`7064`.** At the write-time ref the renderer read `hideEmpty: s.hideEmpty` — a pass-through — so an all-empty section kept its skeleton with zero authoring and nothing needed editing. Falsified by the same restoration: an all-empty AUTHORED section hides again unless the page writes `hideEmpty: false`, so a page that wants the skeleton does have metadata to edit. Where nothing is authored (the direct-`fields` fallback body, the `detail-view` node) the sentence still holds, and the note says so.

⭐ ⛔ Neither note restates a measurement in the undated present tense. These files publish verbatim at an unknown future date, so a fresh present-tense reading would be the same defect with a newer number; every figure in both notes carries the date it was taken.

## 3 — BORN FALSE, so corrected outright

Established at the write-time ref, which is the only place it can be established: `542718f45` added the sentence and, two lines above it in the same hunk, added "`title` is refused by the installed spec, `showBorder` is declared by it" — plus a body comment restating both. It was false the moment it landed. It now says what is true: both are prose readings, neither is a verdict the file takes, and every verdict the cases reach is derived from the installed schema per run. The file that exists to stop rot no longer carries a self-referential falsehood.

⛔ Nothing about the contract moved. Membership of `RENDERER_ONLY_SECTION_KEYS` is unchanged, no assertion changed, and the 16 cases pass.

## 4 — measured, and left where it is

Confirmed false. Across objectui#9627's whole diff for `record-details.hideEmptyRetired-7129.test.tsx`, 2 removed lines carry CJK and 0 added lines do; both removed lines are present at the branch base, so both were pre-existing. Lit control: the same matcher finds those characters in 5+ other tracked files, so the zero on the added side is a real absence and not a broken instrument.

⛔ Reachability, established before planning anything: the sentence exists in two places. The merged PR body is editable through the API; the squash commit message on `main` carries it byte-identically and is immutable. Editing one would leave the two out of step and would still publish nothing, and the card itself rules this the lowest-value of the four and not a published surface. ⇒ named here, not touched.

## Frontmatter — proven, not eyeballed

`check-changeset-overwrite`'s documented case 2. md5 of each frontmatter block, on the merge-base and on the worktree:

```
b60cb98d7733c7ded6acdc59a992dcd1   68B   base        7129-retire-detailviewsection-hideempty.md
b60cb98d7733c7ded6acdc59a992dcd1   68B   worktree    7129-retire-detailviewsection-hideempty.md
733d920ac195fe55936cfacbc2b9dd56   42B   base        7064-empty-section-default.md
733d920ac195fe55936cfacbc2b9dd56   42B   worktree    7064-empty-section-default.md
```

Lit control on the same instrument: whole-file md5 of `7064` differs across the two refs (603bb93d… vs aa225d62…), so the equality above is a measurement, not a stuck hash. The gate agrees and prints "declared at base" identical to "declares now" for both files.

⚠️ The dispatch named `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`; in this repository the script is at `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`. The first invocation exited 1 with MODULE_NOT_FOUND — a wrong path, not a red gate — and was re-run at the real path.

Control-byte self-scan over the four changed paths returns no matches, against a lit control (the same matcher finds a tab in a file that has one).

## Serial constraint — re-taken against the live pull requests

Re-taken immediately before the first write, not carried over from the dispatch. objectui#9726 and objectui#9729 have no open pull request yet; objectui#9732 touches `packages/plugin-grid` only. The three landing points here — two `.changeset/*.md` and one `packages/plugin-detail` test — appear on no other lane's list. The full open set was enumerated and each candidate's file list read.

## Acceptance notes

- ⛔ Not filed, noted only: the repaired parity-test paragraph still writes two derived answers down in prose ("`title` is refused … `showBorder` is declared"), which is the shape commandment #9 warns about. The card explicitly ruled both statements true at 17.4.0, derived per run and not contract-affecting, so removing them is outside this card. Successor: whoever next edits that header.
- ⛔ Not filed, noted only: objectui#9627's own recommendation about `packages/plugin-detail` declaring `@objectstack/spec` at a floor below the version its four-party pin asserts. The card explicitly excludes it and says it wants its own card. Successor: `check:spec-floors`, which owns it.

## Risk

Prose and one test comment. No behavioural line moved, no assertion changed, no frontmatter byte changed, no package bump moved. Rollback is a revert of one commit.
